VocalVideoAPIKeyCredential.title: Vocal Video API Key
VocalVideoAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Create a workspace API key in Vocal Video Settings → API keys. API access must be enabled for the account. Read scope supports get/list tools; write scope is required for mutations. Paste only the key, without Bearer.

starred.description: If true, return only starred collectors.

since_days.description: Restrict to collectors created in the last N days.

sort.description: `newest` (default) by creation recency, `oldest` reverses it, `abc` orders alphabetically by nickname, `most_replies` by response count descending.

VocalVideoListRepliesConfig.description: Find video/audio responses using transcript and respondent filters. Retains locked and pending-indexing indicators; pending indexing does not mean the workspace is empty.

query.description: Full-text search across transcript content, respondent name, job title, and company. Pass when the user's request implies a topic, theme, or keyword (e.g., 'hiring', 'onboarding', 'team culture'). Omit for unfiltered browse by recency.
query.title: Query

response_type.description: Filter by response shape. `testimonial` is the default for customer/employee endorsements (~60% of corpus). `personal_message` is greetings/dedications addressed to specific people. `leadership_message` is exec/leadership outbound to a group. `expert_content` is educational/tutorial from an expert. `hiring_screening` is job/scholarship applications — exclude from marketing storyboards. `impact_story` is beneficiary/program narrative. For most storyboard-building, default to `testimonial` or omit to scan everything.
response_type.title: Response Type

sentiment.description: Filter by inferred sentiment. Useful for 'positive customer testimonials' or 'critical product feedback'. Corpus skews positive — `negative` / `mixed` filters meaningfully narrow.
sentiment.title: Sentiment

specificity.description: Filter by how concrete the response is. `high` = specific outcomes, numbers, named details ('cut deployment time in half'). `low` = generic praise ('game changer', 'top-notch'). Storyboards usually benefit from `medium` or `high`. Pass `high` when the user wants impact-driven content.
specificity.title: Specificity

topics.description: Filter to replies whose extracted topics overlap with these terms (any-match, case-insensitive). Example: ['team culture', 'onboarding'].
topics.title: Topics

collector_id.description: Restrict to one specific collector (a particular ask or survey).
collector_id.title: Collector Id

starred.description: If true, return only starred (favorited) responses.
starred.title: Starred

has_release.description: If true, return only responses with a signed release — safe for public use.
has_release.title: Has Release

since_days.description: Optional narrowing window — restrict to responses from the last N days. Results are already returned in recency order by default; only pass this when the user has expressed an explicit time constraint (e.g. "from this quarter", "last month"). Do NOT pass it for vague phrasings like "recent" — the natural sort handles that.
since_days.title: Since Days

VocalVideoListRepliesConfig.title: VocalVideoListRepliesConfig

VocalVideoListStoryboardsConfig.description: Find workspace videos by content, publication and visibility. Shortlist results are not workspace totals.

query.description: Full-text search across title, internal title, description, and the full transcript. Pass when the user names a topic, theme, or keyword. Omit for unfiltered browse by recency.
query.title: Query

status.description: Filter by lifecycle. `published` covers anything the user has shipped (including publishing-in-progress / errored renders); `draft` covers unfinished editor work. Omit for both. Archived videos are never returned.
status.title: Status

visibility.description: Filter by public visibility. `publicly` = public + searchable; `unlisted` = public link only; `privately` = workspace-only. Useful for "show me public videos" or "find my private drafts".
visibility.title: Visibility

starred.description: If true, return only starred videos (the user's favorites).
starred.title: Starred

since_days.description: Restrict to videos created in the last N days (based on draft creation date). Only pass when the user named an explicit time window ("this quarter", "last month"). For "videos I published this quarter" use `since_published_days` instead. Results are recency-ordered by default — don't pass this for vague "recent".
since_days.title: Since Days

since_published_days.description: Restrict to videos published in the last N days (based on last_published_at). Use this for "newly published", "shipped this quarter", or gallery-refresh asks ("rotate in my newest published videos"). Drafts have no publish date and will not match.
since_published_days.title: Since Published Days

sort.description: `newest` (default) by creation recency, `oldest` reverses it, `play` orders by total play count, `view` by total view count, `published` orders by last publish date (drafts sort last). Pick `play` or `view` for "most popular" / "best performing" asks; pick `published` for "most recently shipped".
sort.title: Sort

invitation_subject.title: Invitation Subject

accept_audio.description: Let a respondent answer with audio only, instead of video.
accept_audio.title: Accept Audio

ask_job_title.description: Ask the respondent for their job title on the attribution step.
ask_job_title.title: Ask Job Title

contact_email.description: Reply-to address for the invitation and reminder emails.

enable_effects.description: Offer background blur to respondents while they record.

prize_drawing.description: Enter respondents in the Vocal Video prize drawing.
prize_drawing.title: Prize Drawing

release_id.description: A custom release from this workspace for respondents to agree to; null uses the workspace default. Only reaches respondents while include_custom_release is on, and a wrong id comes back with the workspace's releases listed.

reward.description: Custom incentive type the customer fulfils themselves; null means none. Describe it in reward_blurb.

reward_blurb.description: Describes the custom incentive to respondents. The editor caps it at 140 characters and nothing else does.
reward_blurb.title: Reward Blurb

show_help.description: Show Help & FAQ links to respondents.
show_help.title: Show Help

show_how_it_works.description: Show the "How it Works" explainer to respondents.

show_spokesperson.description: Show the contact as a spokesperson on the collector pages.
show_spokesperson.title: Show Spokesperson

show_step_numbers.title: Show Step Numbers

include_custom_release.description: Use the workspace's custom release rather than the standard one. Needs a plan with custom releases.
include_custom_release.title: Include Custom Release

kiosk_mode.description: Run the collector as a kiosk: it returns to the start after each response. Overrides the custom thank-you call-to-action. Needs a plan with kiosk mode.
kiosk_mode.title: Kiosk Mode

show_custom_finish_cta.description: Show a custom call-to-action on the thank-you screen instead of the Vocal Video one. Kiosk mode overrides it. Needs a plan without the Vocal Video CTA.

custom_finish_cta_label.description: Button text for the custom thank-you call-to-action.
custom_finish_cta_label.title: Custom Finish Cta Label

custom_finish_cta_message.description: Message above the custom thank-you call-to-action.
custom_finish_cta_message.title: Custom Finish Cta Message

custom_finish_cta_url.description: Where the custom thank-you call-to-action links.
custom_finish_cta_url.title: Custom Finish Cta Url

invitation_body.description: Body copy of the invitation email.
invitation_body.title: Invitation Body

invitation_cta.description: Call-to-action button label on the invitation email.
invitation_cta.title: Invitation Cta

reminder_subject.description: Subject line of the reminder email.
reminder_subject.title: Reminder Subject

reminder_body.description: Body copy of the reminder email.
reminder_body.title: Reminder Body

reminder_cta.description: Call-to-action button label on the reminder email.
reminder_cta.title: Reminder Cta

show_logo.description: Whether the workspace logo appears on the collector's public pages. Set false to hide it.
show_logo.title: Show Logo

template_id.description: Workspace template id (from list_templates) this collector's drafts assemble with — used by auto-assembly and as the reply page's default. Overrides the workspace default template. Pass null — or the current default's id — to clear the override so the collector follows the workspace default, tracking future default changes; the payload then reports template_id: null.
template_id.title: Template Id

auto_assemble_drafts.description: When true, every new finalized response automatically assembles a draft video using the collector's template (or the workspace default).
auto_assemble_drafts.title: Auto Assemble Drafts
